text.p: Scottish premier league side Celtic gave their title hopes a boost on Friday with the signing of Dundee United midfielder David Hannah for 650,000 pounds (1.1 million dollars).

The 23-year-old, who has been involved in a legal wrangle with Dundee United over an option clause in his contract, signed for 4-1/2 years and has been included in the squad for Celtic's game against Dunfermline on Saturday.
His first real test, however, will come on January 2 when Celtic take on league leaders Rangers at Ibrox Park. Rangers lead the premier league by 14 points although Celtic have three games in hand.
